{{Top}}
A '''DEMP gun''', also known as an '''Anti-Droid Electro-Magnetic Pulse gun'''<ref name="MB">[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|''Star Wars Miniatures Battles'', First Edition]]</ref> or '''Destructive ElectroMagnetic Pulse gun''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a personal weapon used to neutralize [[Droid/Legends|droids]] without damaging or destroying them by way of an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]]. The weapon's internal mechanisms were hardened against EMP, and were available in both [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] and [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] varieties. DEMP weapons were manufactured by both [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]].<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
